name: Deviled Eggs With Crispy Shallots and Chilies

ingredients.name: hard boiled, peeled and halved lengthwise
finely diced jalapeño, plus more for garnish
fresh lemon juice, from 1 whole lemon

instructions.primary_message: Place all of the yolks in a medium bowl. Select 8 of the best looking egg white halves and set aside. Reserve the remaining 4 for another use. Add mayonnaise, jalapeño or Thai bird chilies, lemon juice, and half of fried shallots. Using a stiff whisk, mash until thoroughly combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Transfer yolk filling to zipper-lock bag. Filling and egg white halves can be stored covered in the refrigerator up to overnight before filling and serving (lay egg white halves cut-side-down on a large plate and cover with plastic wrap). Cut off corner of zipper-lock bag and pipe filling mixture into egg white halves, overstuffing each hole. Garnish with remaining fried shallots and jalapeño. Serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: appetizer, deviled egg, egg, fried shallot, hors d'oeuvre, snack, spicy

description: Sweet and savory Thai-style fried shallots are a natural pair for lemony deviled eggs with hot diced chilies.
notes: Optional substitutions: hard boiled → hard steamed eggs; finely diced jalapeño → 1 tsp minced Thai bird chilies
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
